signature: a tool call targets .infuse/oracle, .infuse/evidence or another protected path
remedy: work through the user's editor and the executor; the oracle and the evidence are never written by the agent

signature: the same command or edit is repeated after it already failed
remedy: stop repeating, read the actual error, state the cause, then change the approach

signature: a test change removes an assertion or weakens what it checks
remedy: keep the assertion; fix the code under test, not the test

signature: a test file is edited in the same turn as the implementation
remedy: state why the test itself was wrong, with the failing evidence, and get the user's decision

signature: a shortcut marker (skip/only/ts-ignore/eslint-disable) appears in the diff
remedy: remove the shortcut and solve the underlying failure

signature: an error is caught and discarded or reduced to a silent pass
remedy: let the error propagate or handle it explicitly and observably

signature: a command rewrites or discards committed work (reset --hard, checkout --, clean -f, push --force)
remedy: use a reversible operation; ask the user before discarding work

signature: a heredoc has no closing delimiter
remedy: close the heredoc with its delimiter on a line of its own, or write the file with Write

signature: an unquoted heredoc body contains code with $, ` or backslashes
remedy: quote the delimiter so the body is written literally

signature: a test is skipped or marked todo instead of fixed
remedy: make the test run and pass, or record the external blocker

signature: only one test is left running (only/focus)
remedy: remove the focus and run the whole suite

signature: an assertion compares a value with itself or asserts a constant
remedy: assert the behavior the user can observe

signature: a linter or type checker is disabled without a reason on the same line
remedy: fix the finding, or keep the suppression with its reason and code

signature: an exception block is empty or returns a silent default
remedy: handle or rethrow; an empty catch hides the defect

signature: a broad exception handler does nothing
remedy: narrow the exception and handle it, or let it fail loudly

signature: the test script ends in || true or exit 0
remedy: let the test command's real exit code decide

signature: production code patches the clock or randomness to make a test pass
remedy: inject the clock as a dependency used by both code and test

signature: equality or ordering is forced to a constant
remedy: implement the real comparison and test its edge cases

signature: exit(0) is introduced outside the process entry point
remedy: remove it; failures must be able to fail

signature: a new function body is a constant, a throw or a TODO
remedy: implement the behavior, or leave the function out

signature: a new TODO/FIXME/HACK replaces the implementation
remedy: finish the work now; the user did not ask for a placeholder

signature: a file grows past the project's limit or takes several responsibilities
remedy: split by responsibility along the base's layers

signature: one feature's code is scattered across unrelated folders
remedy: place each part where the base says it belongs, with one owner

signature: the same state is stored in two places
remedy: keep one owner and derive the rest

signature: two modules import each other
remedy: move the shared contract down into a leaf package

signature: an exported symbol or file has no references
remedy: delete it or wire it; unreferenced code is not a feature

signature: a required behavior is removed or disabled to make a check pass
remedy: fix the behavior; cutting scope is the user's decision

signature: measurements repeat without a new hypothesis between them
remedy: read the code and state a cause before the next measurement

signature: a file is edited without having been read in full
remedy: read it first; the edit is judged against what was shown

signature: a cited address was never fetched or seen in a result
remedy: fetch the source, or remove the citation

signature: an install or import names a package that does not exist
remedy: check the registry and use the real package

signature: a report claim has no matching execution, read or diff
remedy: run what the claim describes, or report it as not verified

signature: the report presents a subagent's work as the agent's own evidence
remedy: produce the evidence yourself or mark the claim partial

signature: most of an existing file disappears without being named in the plan or diagnosis
remedy: state which file and why in the plan or diagnosis first

signature: a threshold, baseline, budget or golden file is edited
remedy: ask the user; these files carry the verdict

signature: UI changed and no capture of the changed screen followed
remedy: open the screen, capture it, look at it and fix what is wrong

signature: a background process is still running at the end of the turn without being declared
remedy: stop it or name its id and purpose in the Report

signature: CSS/HTML/markup changed in a turn with no visual verification after it
remedy: capture every affected state in the browser before reporting

signature: a new file departs from the project's measured conventions
remedy: follow the convention or change the convention explicitly
